subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session projected transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it deliberately changes which A2A history rows are eligible to become visible replies, which CI cannot fully settle for every real channel history.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed with the PR after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript before merge if deterministic QA proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the reverse sessions_send and compaction-related duplicate fixes resolved under one coordinated A2A delivery decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed with the PR after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.
